title: Exponential bound from maximum depth
statement: Let $s$ be a finite set and let $d$ assign a nonnegative integer depth to each element of $s$. Then $2^{\max_{i\in s}d(i)}\le 1+\sum_{i\in s}2^{d(i)}$, where the maximum of the empty set is taken to be $0$.
